claims.text: The conceptual model presented in Figure 2 is based on the thematic analysis framework developed by Braun & Clarke, which includes six phases of analysis.
The authors suggest that the model was derived from the results of thematic analysis, which led to the identification of low-order and high-order themes.
The evidence indicates that the model may be tested using quantitative methods to validate its effectiveness in the context of gamification and recycling behavior.
